title: Relaxed measurement criterion for a stationary UE

entities.name: Relaxed measurement criterion
entities.description: Criterion that allows a stationary UE to relax measurement reporting requirements based on signal level stability.

entities.name: Srxlev
entities.description: Current signal level value of the PCell in dB.

entities.name: Srxlev_RefStationaryConnected
entities.description: Reference signal level value of the PCell used for relaxed measurement evaluation.

entities.name: RRC reconfiguration procedure
entities.description: Procedure specified in 5.3.5.3 where rrm-MeasRelaxationReportingConfig can be included.

entities.name: RRCReconfiguration message
entities.description: RRC message that may contain rrm-MeasRelaxationReportingConfig configuration.

entities.name: rrm-MeasRelaxationReportingConfig
entities.description: Configuration information element for measurement relaxation reporting.

entities.name: T_SearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected
entities.description: Timer used to evaluate when relaxed measurement criterion has not been met.

relations.description: RRCReconfiguration message contains the rrm-MeasRelaxationReportingConfig IE.
RRC reconfiguration procedure involves sending RRCReconfiguration message.
Relaxed measurement criterion is evaluated using the reference Srxlev value.
Relaxed measurement criterion evaluation considers timer T_SearchDeltaP-StationaryConnected.
Relaxed measurement criterion is evaluated by comparing current Srxlev with reference value.
